While the upper bodies of the flamingos and the turtle shells are rendered with reasonable detail, the interaction points and mechanical structures demonstrate catastrophic AI generation failures. The animal_pose_auditor's HIGH risk level (53% low-confidence keypoints) corroborates these visual observations of anatomical uncertainty and fusion.
